prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 16 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1478; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on collision with a wrist fracture. The reported mechanism is consistent with the type and force of the injury sustained. Initial imaging and reduction were completed, and the patient was placed in immobilization with follow-up scheduled as is standard for this fracture pattern. Over the course of 16 visits, treatment ran somewhat longer than is typical for an injury of this kind, with progressive rehabilitation including range-of-motion exercises, grip strengthening, and monitoring of healing. Several examination findings, including tenderness over the fracture site and reduced grip strength, support the diagnosis, while other neurovascular and sensory testing returned within normal limits. No prior injury to the same area is known from the patient history. Billing records were reviewed and show no duplicate or repeated charges for the same services. Ongoing care is directed toward full functional recovery, with a plan for reassessment at the next scheduled visit.
